physical.title: album; painting; papercut
physical.summary:
Portrait of a royal household dwarf; painting mounted onto an album  folio, B side. Figure is standing looking to right of page, holding castanets and wearing a fur-lined sleeveless coat, a floppy dark hat, and a shirt decorated with ogives. He has a moustache and stubble on his chin. Découpage rosebuds on undulating stems to either side of the portrait. Inscribed. Album  contains sixty folios  with fifty-nine  paintings   of  figures, and additional  découpages, including  floral and vegetal   decoration  in  some margins.

									   Ink and opaque  watercolour, with  découpage on paper. Album covered with    green leather.
